name: BT Quote
changelog:
0.4.1

  • The tool can now be told it does not own the page it is on. On /quote/ nothing changes — the address bar still tracks the quote, which is the point there.
  • Embedded elsewhere (the employee portal's Quote tab), it no longer rewrites the host page's URL, and Copy Quote Link builds a /quote/ link instead of a link to the page it happens to be sitting on. A quote link copied from the portal used to point the customer at the employee portal.
  • Two optional config keys, both defaulting to the old behaviour: syncUrl and shareBase.

0.4.0

  • Every BT plugin now shows the same Updates section in the same place — last on the page, same heading, same button, same wording. Shared file, so they cannot drift apart again.
  • Sidebar order is now alphabetical: BT Accounts, BT Catalog, BT Portal, BT Quote, BT Transfers.

0.3.2

  • The sidebar grouping now includes BT Transfers and BT Accounts, so all the BT tools sit together instead of some drifting off next to Analytics.
  • The group order is filterable via bt_menu_group_order, so a new BT plugin can slot itself in without needing a BT Quote release.

0.3.1

  • The address bar now tracks the tool live — change quantity, garment, locations or method and the URL updates to match, so it is always an accurate quote.
  • Uses replaceState, so adjusting quantity does not stack up back-button steps.
  • Existing tracking params (utm_source, fbclid, …) are preserved when the URL is rewritten.
  • A clean /quote/ stays clean until the customer changes something.
v0.3.0 — Quick Quote tool moved into the plugin as [bt_quick_quote], with prefilled quote links and a Copy Quote Link button.
